name: foodie-express
description: Modern food delivery platform with microservices architecture

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:gateway" "npm run dev:services" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently "npm run dev:user" "npm run dev:restaurant" "npm run dev:menu" "npm run dev:order" "npm run dev:payment" "npm run dev:delivery" "npm run dev:notification" "npm run dev:review" "npm run dev:search"
scripts.dev:frontend: concurrently "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:restaurant-portal" "npm run dev:driver" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:services && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:services: concurrently "cd services/api-gateway && npm install" "cd services/user-service && npm install" "cd services/restaurant-service && npm install" "cd services/menu-service && npm install" "cd services/order-service && npm install" "cd services/payment-service && npm install" "cd services/delivery-service && npm install" "cd services/notification-service && npm install" "cd services/review-service && npm install" "cd services/search-service && npm install"
scripts.install:frontend: concurrently "cd frontend/customer-app && npm install" "cd frontend/restaurant-portal && npm install" "cd frontend/driver-app && npm install" "cd frontend/admin-dashboard && npm install"
scripts.build: npm run build:services && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:services: concurrently "cd services/api-gateway && npm run build" "cd services/user-service && npm run build" "cd services/restaurant-service && npm run build" "cd services/menu-service && npm run build" "cd services/order-service && npm run build" "cd services/payment-service && npm run build" "cd services/delivery-service && npm run build" "cd services/notification-service && npm run build" "cd services/review-service && npm run build" "cd services/search-service && npm run build"
scripts.build:frontend: concurrently "cd frontend/customer-app && npm run build" "cd frontend/restaurant-portal && npm run build" "cd frontend/driver-app && npm run build" "cd frontend/admin-dashboard && npm run build"
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:services: concurrently "cd services/user-service && npm test" "cd services/restaurant-service && npm test" "cd services/menu-service && npm test" "cd services/order-service && npm test" "cd services/payment-service && npm test" "cd services/delivery-service && npm test" "cd services/notification-service && npm test" "cd services/review-service && npm test" "cd services/search-service && npm test"
scripts.test:frontend: concurrently "cd frontend/customer-app && npm test" "cd frontend/restaurant-portal && npm test" "cd frontend/driver-app && npm test" "cd frontend/admin-dashboard && npm test"

author: FoodieExpress Team
